plants.sentence: Although the range is heavily influenced by outliers, the interquartile range, the difference between the first and third quartiles, is no better: it is not resistant to outliers either.
With skewed data the mean is always useless as a representative value and the median must always be used; the mean is only valid when the data are perfectly symmetric.
In a skewed distribution the mean is pulled away from the skew: a heavier right tail puts the mean below the median, and a heavier left tail puts it above.
The most common histogram splits the range of the data into equal-sized bins, called classes, counts how many data points fall into each bin, and works best with between 5 and 20 bins.
Column proportions divide each count by its column total; when these rates differ across the levels of one variable, that shows the one variable causes the other.
